tools.name: mbc_list_bookmakers
tools.description: List all 45 supported bookmakers with their canonical keys, aliases, code format hints, and capability flags (supports_book, supports_search, supports_tracking, supports_split, conversion_mode, countries). Costs 0 credits. Note: bare '1xbet' and 'afropari' are retired; use '1xng'/'1xglobal' and 'afr

tools.name: mbc_list_markets
tools.description: List all canonical betting markets (1X2, Over/Under, Both Teams To Score, Double Chance, Asian Handicap, European Handicap, totals) and their valid outcome names for resolving and booking games. Names only; a bookmaker may list only some of them. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_get_usage
tools.description: Read the caller's active plan, key charge_order, API credits (monthly plan plus never-expiring packs), regular daily credits, rate limit windows, and active jobs and tracks. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_view_slip
tools.description: Load a booking code on a bookmaker and return all games, markets, outcomes, odds, live scores, kickoff times, and total odds. Costs 1 credit after a successful read; failed lookups cost 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_view_slip_image
tools.description: Render a branded PNG slip image for a booking code on a bookmaker. Returns an MCP ImageContent block (image/png) plus a summary. Costs 2 credits after a successful render; failed renders cost 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_convert_code
tools.description: Convert a booking code from one source bookmaker to 1 target bookmaker or a synchronous batch of up to 6 target bookmakers. Costs 2 credits per target that produces a code; failed targets are automatically refunded. To convert to all bookmakers at once (up to 29), use mbc_convert_to_all.

tools.name: mbc_convert_to_all
tools.description: Convert one booking code to all 29 default target bookmakers at once (up to 29 target bookmakers: SportyBet, 1xBet Global, 1xBet NG, MSport, Paripesa, 22Bet, Megapari, 888starz, Afropari NG, Afropari Global, Betwinner, Melbet, Helabet, Fastpari, Xparibet, Goldpari, 1xBit, WinWinBet, DBBet, Paripulse

tools.name: mbc_bulk_convert
tools.description: Convert 2 to 4 source booking codes synchronously across all or selected target bookmakers in one batch (each slip's own source bookmaker is automatically excluded from its targets). Costs 2 credits per successful (code, target) pair; failed pairs cost 0 credits. For 5 to 20 source codes, use mbc_ma

tools.name: mbc_split_code
tools.description: Divide one booking code into 2 to 20 smaller codes on the same bookmaker so every game lands in exactly one new code. Supports 4 split methods: 'equal' (spread games evenly across codes), 'by_batches' (keep consecutive games together in each code), 'target_odds' (group games to reach a chosen combin

tools.name: mbc_merge_codes
tools.description: Combine 2 to 30 booking codes (from the same or different bookmakers) into one deduplicated booking code on a target bookmaker. Reports any skipped, dropped, or conflicting games. Costs 2 credits for the first code, plus 1 credit for each other code on the target bookmaker and 2 credits for each cod

tools.name: mbc_search_events
tools.description: Search up to 20 team or head-to-head match queries ('Arsenal vs Chelsea', 'Real Madrid') on a bookmaker. Returns event IDs, kickoff times, confidence ('exact' or 'fuzzy'), and top canonical markets. Spends 1 work unit per query against the daily cap. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_get_event_markets
tools.description: Fetch markets, lines, outcomes, and live odds for one event_id on a bookmaker. Start with names_only=true to learn the market names, then request one or more names with market= or narrow with q=. view=all adds native markets (canonical: false) and needs market= or q=. tools.name: mbc_resolve_picks
tools.description: Validate 1 to 50 games (team names or event_ids plus canonical market, outcome, and optional line/odds) on a target bookmaker and create a 10-minute plan_id for mbc_book_code. Returns per-game status ('resolved', 'ambiguous', 'not_found', 'market_missing', 'odds_changed', 'not_bookable'). Spends 1 w

tools.name: mbc_book_code
tools.description: Mint a new verified booking code on 1 to 6 target bookmakers from either a plan_id (from mbc_resolve_picks) or direct picks. A key pick fans out within its family directly, and across families when bookmaker names the brand that minted the key. Costs 2 credits per target code created; refunded if no

tools.name: mbc_manage_tracking
tools.description: Manage live match tracking for SportyBet, Football.com, and Betway slips. Actions: 'start' (costs 1 credit; mode 'ticket' fast-fails on a cut, 'game' tracks to the end), 'get' (0 credits), 'list' (0 credits), 'stop' (0 credits).

tools.name: mbc_manage_jobs_and_history
tools.description: Create, inspect, list, or cancel async jobs (for >6 targets or up to 20 source codes, requires Developer/Scale/Business API plan), or query past conversion history and book history (0 credits for reads).
